name: WayriCAD Protocol Constraint Composer
description: Detect protocol nets and compose reviewed KiCad custom design rules.
description_full: Detects common USB, CAN, Ethernet, PCIe/SerDes, DDR, RS-485, and RF net-name conventions, presents editable assignments, and generates a clearly delimited WayriCAD-managed custom-rule block. Rules can be exported or applied to the project .kicad_dru after confirmation and timestamped backup.
